versions.name: pick

versions.name: getFov
versions.why: FOV state moved onto Camera in 26.1 and the getter lost its arguments. The same helper reads the arity off the descriptor, so the call site does not branch on a version number

versions.name: setSelectedHotbarSlot

the pre-26.3 way to get the outline pass to run at all. Absent on 26.2, which has neither this nor the 26.3 field -- that gap is unsolved

WHEN to submit. It hands over both things the in-world ESP needs -- the PoseStack and the collector -- at the moment the frame is taking entity geometry, which is exactly where entity boxes belong. Present on all six versions of the submit era, unlike submitFeatures which starts at 26.2. Neither Sodium 0.8.6/0.9.1 nor Iris 1.11.3 names it in any mixin: both mix into LevelRenderer but target renderLevel, which is what the abandoned JNIHook attached to and why the world went blank
